preconditioning.notes: Page: "when navigating to a charging station or activated by the driver".

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Subaru Canada release: "powered by a 77.0-kWh lithium-ion battery" (usable not stated).
Subaru USA release: 74.7 kWh. Conflicts with Subaru Canada 77.0 kWh (NRCan 446 km vs EPA 278-288 mi suggests the same pack).

ac_max_kw.notes: Subaru Canada: "an improved 11kW onboard charger". Existing 6.6 kW (Chargeprice archive) is the older Solterra.

dc_max_kw.notes: Subaru Canada: DCFC "at speeds of approximately 150 kW"; Subaru USA "up to an estimated 150 kW".

supercharger_access.notes: Drive Tesla Canada relays Subaru: all Solterra owners can access more than 25,000 Superchargers in Canada and the US via the SubaruConnect app; InsideEVs tested the 2026 car on a V3 Supercharger. (Subaru Canada's Newswire release itself footnotes access as 'anticipated'.)

heat_pump.notes: CarGurus Canada review: "a heat pump is standard in Canada". Subaru pages do not mention it.
